CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_shop_key(_input text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE (SECURITY INVOKER, no search_path set). Body: SELECT regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(_input, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'). Uppercases and strips all non-alphanumerics for fuzzy shop-number matching.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_inspection_subsection(_site_id uuid, _json jsonb) RETURNS TABLE(resolved_id uuid, match_count int, shop_number text, firebase_key text) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SET search_path = public (SECURITY INVOKER). Reads _json->>'subsectionId' (firebase key) and _json->'generalInfo'->>'shopNumber'. First tries exact match on subsections.firebase_id within _site_id; if found returns (id,1,...). Else counts subsections where normalize_shop_key(name)=normalize_shop_key(shop) within site; if exactly 1, returns that id; if >1 returns NULL id with the count; if 0 returns NULL id, 0. Touches public.subsections.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inspections_auto_link_subsection() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public (SECURITY INVOKER). When NEW.subsection_id IS NULL AND NEW.json_data IS NOT NULL AND NEW.site_id IS NOT NULL, calls resolve_inspection_subsection(NEW.site_id, NEW.json_data) and, if a single match resolves, sets NEW.subsection_id := resolved id. Returns NEW. Trigger function for inspections.

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS then CREATE TRIGGER trg_inspections_auto_link_subsection BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF json_data, subsection_id ON public.inspections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.inspections_auto_link_subsection().

Anonymous DO $$ block: loops over inspections WHERE subsection_id IS NULL AND site_id IS NOT NULL AND json_data IS NOT NULL. For each, calls resolve_inspection_subsection; on single match UPDATEs inspections.subsection_id, backfills subsections.firebase_id (when firebase_key present and subsection lacks it), and INSERTs an inspection_relink_audit row with resolution 'auto_relinked'. On no/multiple match, INSERTs audit row with resolution 'multiple_matches' or 'no_match'. Mutates inspections, subsections, and inspection_relink_audit.

Reads client_access_links (via helper), settings, clients, sites, subsections, snags.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_subsection_review(p_token text, p_subsection_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public. Resolves v_link via public._share_link(p_token); looks up the subsection's site_id and site.client_id; returns NULL on invalid token, non-existent subsection, or failed scope check (Vuln 6): if link.client_id set, site.client_id must match; elsif link.site_id set, site_id must match; elsif link.subsection_id set, p_subsection_id must match; else NULL.
